old_description: A & E Kitchen Service LLC, founded in 2000 provides service for our customers and manufacturers of commercial kitchen equipment.  Servicing commercial cooking, preparation, holding, sanitation, refrigeration, warewashing equipment and HVAC needs for restaurants, churches, convenience stores, hospitals, hotels, schools, and institutions throughout southwest Missouri.
about:
A & E Kitchen Service LLC was founded in 2000 in Springfield, Missouri. The company began as a service provider for commercial kitchen equipment, serving customers and manufacturers across the region.

The firm specializes in repair, maintenance, and installation of commercial cooking, preparation, holding, sanitation, refrigeration, warewashing, and HVAC equipment. Its service department fields five technicians, a dispatcher, and a parts manager, and provides factory-authorized warranty coverage for more than 150 equipment brands. Services include preventive maintenance programs, water filtration, start-up, sight surveys, minor construction, electrical, plumbing, and on-site or shop welding.

Customers span restaurants, churches, convenience stores, hospitals, hotels, schools, and other institutions throughout southwest Missouri, including the Springfield, Branson, and Joplin areas.

The company emphasizes its geographic reach and technical depth as a way for clients to consolidate equipment support. It offers 24-hour weekend and emergency service with direct technician contact—no call center—and notes that its factory-trained technicians average at least 15 years of experience in electric, gas, steam, and refrigeration systems.

name: A & W Sheet Metal and Industrial Contractors, LLC
old_description: Located at West Monroe, LA. A & W Sheet Metal and Industrial Contractors, LLC Specializes in metal fabrication, sheet metal work, TIG welding, drilling, grinding, etc. Free Estimates. Family-Owned Business. In Business for 35+ Years. Call us for a FREE estimate.
about:
A & W Sheet Metal and Industrial Contractors, LLC operates from West Monroe, Louisiana. The company was founded over 35 years ago by Rick Auttonberry as a Christian family-owned business, with a mission to deliver high-quality products at competitive prices while prioritizing safety for employees and customers.

The shop provides a range of metal fabrication services including CNC high-definition plasma cutting, plate rolling, bending up to 3/8-inch thick material, and rolling up to 1/2-inch thick material. Additional capabilities cover TIG welding, drilling, grinding, automated metal fabrication, and industrial plant maintenance with multi-skilled mechanics and millwrights. The company also installs, maintains, and repairs HVAC systems, and fabricates and installs paper machine hood components, ductwork, chutes, fan systems, platforms, catwalks, handrails, stairs, and ladder cages across Louisiana, Texas, Arkansas, Mississippi, and Alabama.

Its customer base includes major packaging and paper manufacturers such as Graphic Packaging, Georgia Pacific, International Paper, WestRock, Green Bay Packaging, and PCA, as well as biomass producer Drax Biomass, aluminum extruder SAPA, packaging supplier Bemis, and institutional clients including hospitals, universities, and schools.

The founder’s stated goal remains the company’s guiding principle: to provide a high-quality product at a competitive price while keeping safety first for employees and customers in the timeliest manner possible, giving all glory to God.

about:
A Team Apparel operates from Prairie City, Iowa. The business was founded by husband-and-wife team Bruce and Cheryl Burkland, who aimed to assemble a crew of graphic designers and silkscreen printers. In 2026, Libby, founder of 515 Creative Designs (established 2018), acquired the company and merged it with her design firm to form 515 A*Team.

The shop specializes in custom-decorated apparel, offering screen printing, direct-to-film (DTF) heat transfers, and in-house graphic design. They source a wide range of garments—including ringspun cotton, tri-blend, performance polyester, fleece, and high-visibility safety wear—and handle orders from a 12-piece minimum for screen printing up to large volumes, with price breaks at 25, 37, 51, and 101 units. The company reports having designed and printed over one million shirts without missing a deadline.

Customers include event organizers, businesses, and organizations needing branded or promotional wear. A noted example is Crossroads of Pella, which relies on A Team Apparel for its annual Klompen Classic race T-shirts. The firm also serves clients requiring safety-compliant outerwear and corporate identity apparel.

The founders’ original vision was to “wow customers” through creative design, quick turnaround, and reasonable pricing. The current team emphasizes that graphic design and apparel selection are included at no extra charge with an order, and they offer DTF decoration for smaller runs that fall below screen-print minimums.

about:
A-Auto Salvage opened in 1990 in Little Rock, Arkansas, as a family-owned and operated business. The founders brought a combined 50 years of experience in the automotive industry to the venture, establishing a salvage yard focused on used parts and repair services.

The company operates a salvage yard where customers can hand-pick components from late-model and older vehicles, including engines, transmissions, tires, batteries, rear ends, and interior pieces. It also stocks a selection of new parts and provides auto repair services such as fuel system work and manufacturer-recommended maintenance. The yard serves Pulaski, Saline, Garland, Lonoke, and Jefferson counties, offering same-day pickup for purchased vehicles.

A-Auto Salvage supplies parts for a wide range of makes — Ford, GM, Dodge, Honda, Hyundai, Nissan, Mazda, Toyota, Kia, Subaru, Lexus, BMW, Audi, Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz, and Jaguar — catering to independent repair shops, collision centers, and DIY mechanics. Its inventory emphasizes hard-to-find components for older models that many suppliers no longer carry.

The business differentiates itself through personal service: a live person always answers the phone, pricing is competitive, and the hands-on approach has built a loyal customer base over three decades. The owners attribute their longevity to expertise, customer satisfaction, and the ability to locate parts that are not in stock.

name: A-Pac Manufacturing
old_description: We are your trusted, industry-leading manufacturer of made to order, high-quality poly bags and plastic film products made right here in the USA.
about:
A-Pac Manufacturing has operated from Grand Rapids, Michigan since its founding in 1988. The company produces custom poly bags, plastic liners, and plastic film products for a range of industrial and food-grade applications. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed, but the business has remained independent for over three decades, emphasizing direct customer relationships and domestic production.

The manufacturer runs a made-to-order operation that includes polyethylene tubing, SWS and CF sheeting, and various bag configurations built to customer specifications. While facility size and headcount are not published, the company cites lead times of two to three weeks and highlights investments in machinery that provide tight process control. Quality management follows ISO 9001:2015, and the plant also holds FSSC 22000 certification for food safety.

A-Pac serves medical device packagers and food processors, among others. Oliver Products Medical Division has sourced clean, high-quality bags from the company since at least 2007, and R.W. Bakers has used its poly bags for baked goods since 2002. Both customers note consistent quality, responsive service, and willingness to consolidate SKUs or adjust materials to reduce cost.

The company positions itself on three pillars: every bag is custom-made, lead times are kept to two to three weeks, and all products are manufactured in the United States from premium raw materials. Certifications to ISO 9001:2015 and FSSC 22000 back the quality claims, and the sales and customer-service teams are staffed by named individuals rather than automated systems.

old_description: At A-Z Solar Services we combine years of experience with industry leading technology to provide our customers with high performance electrical and renewable energy systems. We designed our business plan around our installers creating personal relationships with our customers. We do not have a sales team. The installer that performs your site analysis will also install your system and see the project from start to finish. about:
A-Z Solar Services LLC operates from Mandeville, Louisiana, in the Greater New Orleans area. The company is owned and operated by solar energy installers who turned their passion for renewable energy into a profession. Unlike many solar firms, it was built without a dedicated sales force; instead, the installer who conducts the site analysis also designs the system and oversees the installation from start to finish.

The firm provides solar electric and solar hot water system installation and maintenance, specializing in hybrid, grid-tie, and off-grid configurations. Each system is custom-designed to match the customer's energy needs. In addition to renewable energy work, the company offers a range of electrical services under its 'Next Level Electrical Service' banner.

A-Z Solar Services primarily serves homeowners and businesses across the Greater New Orleans region. Its customer base includes residential clients seeking rooftop arrays and commercial property owners looking for integrated solar and electrical solutions. The company emphasizes long-term relationships, positioning the installer as the ongoing point of contact for any future service or questions.

By eliminating a separate sales layer, the company aims to ensure clear communication and accountability throughout the project lifecycle.

about:
A2Z Electronics LLC operates from Elgin, Illinois, delivering PCB assembly and turnkey electronics contract manufacturing services. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

The firm provides end-to-end electronics manufacturing, including surface-mount (SMT) and through-hole (THT) PCB assembly, BGA assembly with X-ray inspection, engineering support for PCB layout and design for manufacturability, custom cable and wire harness assembly, box-build integration, and conformal coating and potting. It handles rapid prototyping through high-volume production, offering 24-hour turnaround for select prototype or low-volume builds and same-day, three-day, or five-day production cycles. Facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

A2Z serves medical device, transportation, defense, lighting, industrial, aerospace, and consumer electronics sectors. Its customer base ranges from startups to high-volume OEMs seeking scalable, cost-effective manufacturing.

The company emphasizes fast, flexible turnaround times, an ISO 13485 and AS9100D certified facility, responsive support with 24-hour replies, and advanced equipment such as a Panasonic pick-and-place machine capable of 25 µm placement accuracy.

name: AAA Auto Wrecking
old_description: AAA Auto Wrecking has been proudly serving the Puget Sound for over 30 years! Trust us to get you the auto part you need for a low price. If you need a part that cannot be found on our lot, we can special order it for you.
about:
Binford Auto Wrecking operates at 26311 78th Avenue South in Kent, Washington. The business has served the Puget Sound region for more than three decades, originally under the name AAA Auto Wrecking before adopting its current identity. The same location and phone number have been used throughout the transition, and the yard continues to function as a full-service auto salvage operation.

The yard stocks used components from hundreds of cars and trucks, including engines, transmissions, alternators, radiators, wheels, and tires. In addition to parts sales, the company purchases vehicles of all makes and models and offers no-cost pickup for unwanted cars and trucks. Customers can also request pickup or delivery of parts and place special orders for items not currently in stock. Inventory turns over continuously, so the business advises calling ahead with vehicle details to confirm availability.

The operation serves individual vehicle owners, independent repair shops, and other automotive businesses primarily in King and Pierce counties. Its customer base ranges from DIY mechanics looking for affordable replacement parts to professional shops sourcing components for rebuilds and repairs.

The company emphasizes extracting maximum value from every vehicle it processes, a principle reflected in its "More value from every vehicle" messaging. By combining parts sales, vehicle purchasing, and free removal, it aims to provide a convenient, low-cost alternative to new parts and traditional disposal.
